learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected 33% for three-to-one against and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Moved one block from Lose to Win: three losses, one win, 25%. Moved second: two and two, 50%, reveal unlocked. Moved third: one loss, three wins, 75%. Four-block total remained constant.
observations.reveal: Corrected 25% for original three-to-one case. Explains one win out of all four, not one in three. Uses tested two/two to explain evens and distinguishes odds denominator from chance denominator.
observations.visual: Inline initial and two/two screenshots inspected: two labelled boxes, four movable blocks and four-segment share bar. Two green segments at 50%, ratio and fraction readouts legible. Trust count 5/5 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884151 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.

prediction.reason: Clear odds-against wording with plausible denominator and direction confusions.

interaction.reason: Moving blocks exposes ratio and total-share distinction across three states.

payoff.reason: Connects actual block states to denominator distinction and equivalent odds.
payoff.evidence: One out of four, two/two equals evens.

clarity.reason: Labelled boxes, constant four blocks and explicit ratios/fractions make path clear.

transfer.reason: Reusable odds-versus-probability rule provided, but no concrete fresh denominator or new application.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard, focus, contrast audit, phone, zoom/reflow and motion unknown.

surprise.reason: 33% prediction overturned by visible four-part total.
surprise.evidence: One green out of four gives25%.

visualExplanation.reason: Movable blocks and segmented share bar carry denominator mechanism.

playfulness.reason: Independent reversible block moves permit ratio exploration.
playfulness.evidence: Three moved blocks and retained total.

practicalValue.reason: Concrete interpretation of quoted odds central.

depth.reason: Ratio direction, whole denominator and equivalent evens linked.

complexity.reason: One supported part-to-part versus part-to-whole comparison using four objects.

whyCool: Moving a single block to Win turns three-to-one against into a visible one-in-four chance rather than one-in-three.
caveat: Four-block system only; no other total, pricing margin or fresh conversion task.
